title: DataKernelBench: Can LLMs Optimize Database Queries on GPUs?
abstract: arXiv:2608.25061v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: GPUs increasingly accelerate database systems, but query-specific peak performance still often relies on hand-written kernels. Existing LLM kernel benchmarks focus on machine learning operators, leaving irregular, heterogeneous, data-movement-heavy database-style operators untested. We introduce DataKernelBench, which translates SQL into validated PyTorch TorchPlan programs and evaluates LLMs that optimize either the core tensor-bounded snippet or the full query in CUDA or Triton through execution-guided repair. Across ten proprietary and open-weight models on TPC-H SF10 with an H100 GPU, the strongest full-query CUDA configuration achieves $2.11\times$ speedup over torch.compile at full pass rate. We find that higher-performing implementations commonly use kernel fusion and execution-strategy changes, stronger models benefit most from full-query specialization, and workload context matters more than hardware context. translated_title: DataKernelBench：大语言模型能否在GPU上优化数据库查询？
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25061v1 公告类型：新 摘要：GPU日益加速数据库系统，但查询特定的峰值性能通常仍依赖手写内核。现有的大语言模型内核基准测试专注于机器学习算子，未测试不规则、异构、数据移动密集型的数据库风格算子。我们引入了DataKernelBench，它将SQL转换为经过验证的PyTorch TorchPlan程序，并评估大语言模型通过执行引导修复来优化核心张量受限片段或完整查询（使用CUDA或Triton）的能力。在TPC-H SF10数据集和H100 GPU上对十个专有和开源权重模型进行的测试中，最强的完整查询CUDA配置在完全通过率下比torch.compile实现了$2.11\times$的加速。我们发现，性能更高的实现通常采用内核融合和执行策略更改，更强的模型从完整查询专业化中获益最多，且工作负载上下文比硬件上下文更重要。为处理大数据...
tldr: 本文提出了DataKernelBench基准测试，证明大语言模型能通过执行引导修复在GPU上优化数据库查询，最强配置实现2.11倍加速，并发现内核融合、完整查询专业化和工作负载上下文是关键因素。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces DataKernelBench benchmark, demonstrating that LLMs can optimize database queries on GPUs via execution-guided repair, achieving 2.11x speedup with the strongest configuration, and identifying kernel fusion, full-query specialization, and workload context as key factors.
